rationale: BLOCKED, leaning YES for the order as a continuing policy and structure. I read the complete held EO 13546 (75 FR 39439, July 2, 2010, Optimizing the Security of Biological Select Agents and Toxins): sec. 1 policy; secs. 2-3 definitions and findings; sec. 4 tiering of the Select Agent List within 18 months; sec. 5 rule proposals (15 months) and final rules (27 months); sec. 6 coordination plans (6 months) and a recurring annual review of inconsistent agency requirements (a continuing duty); sec. 7 establishes the Federal Experts Security Advisory Panel chartered for 4 years subject to renewal, and the NSABB advisory role; sec. 8 information sharing; sec. 9 biennial National Security Staff review and general provisions. It contains no revocation, no sunset of the whole order and no savings clause. The sole history observation is an empty catalog note. The deadlines are spent one-time tasks, which do not by themselves end an order that also has continuing duties (sec. 6(b) annual review, sec. 9(a) biennial review), and the U.S. Code prints it as a note with no ending statement; but without an attributed held slice and a check through 2026-10-14 I cannot write a YES, and without an ending instrument I cannot write a NO.
